before: A valid hidden VP9 keyframe at PTS=100 ticks stretches native duration from the stated 3 ticks (60ms) to 101 ticks (2.02s). Three hidden positions reproduce it; decoded output/interval controls pass. Initial baseline and an explicit before-source replay both produce 1 passing control and 1 failing aggregate duration test.
replay: test-before-replay.rs filters the three original V0 witnesses and omits the subsequently added header getter assertions, so it compiles against the retained before-source snapshots and reproduces the same 2.02s failures. The final test includes additional V1/coarse-clock/unknown-header cases.
change: Retain positive known tkhd and mvhd durations separately from raw media duration. Native composition estimation uses the selected-track bound, falling back to a known movie bound, while tolerating sub-movie-tick header quantization. Unknown/zero markers are not finite bounds. Track-header vector capacity is included in estimated index payload bytes. Track objects, existing clocks and edit windows retain their semantics.
after: 51 checks pass in 10 player-enabled targets, 0 failed/ignored; no-default-features cargo check passes. Exact neutral pixels/RGB and presentation intervals, early/non-display output, seek/rewind/EOF, positive CTS and equal-PTS endpoint controls, layered seek coverage, edits, concat, fragments and malformed time headers are covered.
fixtures: 26 short movies plus manifest (27 files): hidden positions 0/1/2, tkhd V0/V1, zero/unknown duration markers with known movie fallback, and floor/ceil coarse movie-clock positive-CTS controls. Regeneration is byte-identical; the original positive-CTS 19-file corpus also regenerates identically after the generator-only show flag extension.
resources: No packet scan or decode is added to duration queries. The metadata endpoint scan remains cached; the new private duration vector is charged by its capacity and element size.
limits: When both movie and track duration are absent/unknown, the fallback remains a nominal index-based estimate; precise codec-output duration in that case is not claimed.
No physical GPU/NVIDIA or UI interaction claim. Actual software NativeReader playback was exercised.
The complete project suite is not claimed green; historical unrelated failures remain separate.
